description: This file contains the implementation of the Coupon class in the OpenCart platform, located under the namespace Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Total. It defines methods for calculating total discounts related to coupons, confirming, and unconfirming coupon usage during the checkout process.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Defines the Coupon class which manages coupon discount calculations, confirmation, and unconfirmation within the checkout process.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total discount amount based on the coupon session data, updates totals and taxes accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Verifies and records the usage of a coupon during order confirmation, manages coupon usage limits.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes coupon usage records linked to an order, used during order cancellations or modifications.
